scope: Design only: three fixed nominal 120-second FULL_RESTART holding attempts using the frozen isolated coherent-cycle overlay, original helper and native recorder, without actual-clock injection, optional clock traces or exit-phase observations.
assessment: The fixed three-run, stop-on-first-failure design is an appropriate next nominal discriminator after the separately accepted repaired injected diagnostic. It does not replace the remaining search, fresh-run and visual acceptance gates.

Using a separate worker and the original helper avoids modifying the accepted diagnostic evidence and original finish/Stop predicates. The original helper requires exactly 120 seconds and retains the one-second writer finish; the plan preserves the exact bounded guardian and all intervention deadlines.

Exact owner and node role maps remain necessary with observers disabled. Owner evidence must attest the R transport in the Python owner; node evidence must attest the C manager/hardware and linked diagnostic DSOs plus R native, with PID/start/UID/session/executable and path/device/inode/SHA binding. A linked default-off diagnostic DSO is compatible with this nominal design.

Independent full-stream readback for all three native controllers is a meaningful strengthening beyond the original helper neck-only timing checks, provided original protocol records and controller-specific stream semantics remain intact.

The original helper explicitly allows its own graph observation to remain nonempty before owner exit. Its graph_empty value must be retained verbatim; successful outer postflight requires the independently observed empty graph and exact owned-process retirement.
The repaired production control_cycle header is called by the node independently of tracing; disabling trace and probe does not disable the coherent simulation-time dispatch.

implementation_acceptance_conditions.requirement: Enforce absence of optional clock/probe/exit configuration in the effective merged parent/owner/resource-plan child environment, not only in inputs.json. Verify the exact original helper SHA and absence of diagnostic owner bootstrap/wrapper activation; retain original native timing output. Do not invoke clock/phase readers or require their outputs for nominal runs.

For every controller, parse and validate the complete retired raw stream and status, exact controller ID, valid record kinds/readiness, counts, no loss/fault, full update sequence, all relevant original duration/period bounds, and at least 60000 updates within the original monotonic hold interval. Preserve original continuous_updates semantics: full update sequence continuity and 2ms simulated increments within the hold interval. Record pre-hold simulation discontinuities explicitly rather than silently dropping them or treating an expected startup reset as a hold failure. Never exempt a discontinuity within the hold. Apply neck proof/publication predicates according to the actual controller record schema, not a fabricated requirement that all controllers emit neck-only records.

Require original owner rc0 and report qualified true/problem absent, original verified seal and strict startup/Stop/close, original child rc0, exact role maps and PID/start absence, independent postflight graph rc0/empty, and no cancellation/fallback/forced cleanup. Persist and validate exact guardian stdout/schema, actual tool rc0 and worker rc0 with all_owned_absent and no error/intervention before promoting the run or launching the next fixed row. Do not promote a provisional worker PASS alone.

Prepare fresh per-run canonical IPC, inputs, outputs, ROS homes and NVMe scratch with frozen source/install/helper bindings. Retain all three fixed result rows, including failure and subsequent NOT_RUN; no automatic replacement or until-green retry. Preserve original one-second Stop/writer and native grace, as well as exact guardian deadlines.

Before launch, complete the planned meaningful negative tests and independent worker/launch review. Include controller omission/truncation/count/status/identity/sequence/period/body/hold-continuity failures; inherited observer activation; bad/missing guardian result or actual rc; missing map/retirement/graph/seal evidence; and advancement refusal after the first failed row. Generated fixtures remain offline evidence, not nominal runtime results.
